newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Philippines Ramos set to return home from hospital.
newsitem.headline: Philippines Ramos set to return home from hospital.

text.p: Philippine President Fidel Ramos will be discharged from hospital later on Wednesday, two days after undergoing an operation to remove a blockage in a major artery, news reports said.
State television said Ramos would return home after he was visited in his hospital suite by former president Corazon Aquino.
Ramos, 68, underwent surgery on Monday to remove a cholesterol blockage in his right carotid artery, one of the main passages carrying blood to the brain.
Officials said the affliction could have been life-threatening.

But Ramos has recovered well and was shown on television on Wednesday sunbathing on a balcony at the Makati Medical Centre. Dressed in only a pair of trousers, he was chewing on an unlit cigar and reading a magazine.
Ramos told reporters on Tuesday he wanted to spend Christmas Day with his grandchildren.
"He is well," surgeon Jorge Garcia told reporters. "His brain and artery are just as good as anybody his age."
